fusions.name: Fang From Nowhere
fusions.desc: Throws a venomed sliver that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds, with 50% more critical chance against a target that has not been hurt yet.

fusions.name: Scattered Slivers
fusions.desc: Throws 3 venomed slivers in a spread out to 7 tiles, each of which deals 10 damage. Your afflictions on each target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Edge in the Dark
fusions.desc: Veils you for 5 seconds. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Between the Plates
fusions.desc: Your piercing attacks ignore 15% of the target's armour.
